extraction.summary_en: This filing is the constitutive statutes (and related commissaire aux apports report) of SAS HADEAN, dated 7 September 2007, filed with the Toulouse registry. It records that Xavier AUMONT and Franck GICQUEL contributed in kind (apport en nature) all of the ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES shares they held (742 and 80 shares respectively, out of ARCHEAN's 2,000 shares / 200,000 € capital) to HADEAN in exchange for HADEAN shares, making HADEAN a new shareholder of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES with 822 shares. The document also recalls, in passing, ARCHEAN's capital-increase history (17 May 2005 and 20 October 2006) and a prior share acquisition by AUMONT (16 August 2005), without giving amounts.

evidence.quote_fr: Monsieur Xavier AUMONT fait apport de la pleine propriété des 742 (sept cent quarante deux) actions de 100 Euros de valeur nominale chacune qu'il possède de la Société ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES

events.date_basis: Text describes the 80 shares contributed without an explicit residual holding, suggesting this was GICQUEL's full ARCHEAN stake, consistent with the origin-of-property clause (no mention of a remaining position).

evidence.quote_fr: Monsieur Franck GICQUEL fait apport de la pleine propriété des QUATRE VINGT (80) actions de 100 Euros de valeur nominale chacune de la Société ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES, décrite à l'article 6.1 ci-dessus.

events.gloss_en: GICQUEL likely exits ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES's cap table, but the document does not explicitly say these were all his shares.

snapshots.as_of_basis: Capital of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES as stated in the HADEAN constitutive act (presentation of the company whose shares are contributed), reflecting the situation just before the 7 September 2007 contribution.

evidence.quote_fr: Son capital social est actuellement fixé à DEUX CENT MILLE (200.000) euros et est divisé en 2.000 actions de 100 euros de valeur nominale.

snapshots.as_of_basis: Holdings of AUMONT and GICQUEL in ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES just before their contribution to HADEAN, as described in the apport articles.

evidence.quote_fr: Monsieur Xavier AUMONT fait apport de la pleine propriété des 742 ... actions ... qu'il possède de la Société ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES ... Monsieur Franck GICQUEL fait apport de la pleine propriété des QUATRE VINGT (80) actions ... de la Société ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES

issues: The document never gives a full cap table of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES (2,000 shares total); only AUMONT's 742 and GICQUEL's 80 (822 total) are described, leaving 1,178 shares/holders unaccounted for in this filing.
No amounts are given for ARCHEAN's capital increases of 17 May 2005 and 20 October 2006, nor for the share acquisition of 16 August 2005 by AUMONT (seller not named).

SHAREHOLDER_END for AUMONT and GICQUEL is inferred from wording implying they contributed shares they 'possess'/own outright, but the filing does not use the explicit 'totalité des actions détenues' phrasing; treat with caution, especially for GICQUEL.
